name: FA_APPROVAL_SUMMARY_
description: This table stores the approval summary of each asset transaction that passes through the Asset Transactions Approval Workflow process. The process inserts one record for the final approval status.

columns.name: APPROVAL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction approval cycle.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which the asset is recorded.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique code used to identify each asset transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier stored in the transaction interface table for the asset transaction.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mass transaction.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the asset transaction approval.

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPROVED
columns.description: Transaction amount approved by the approver.

columns.name: PROCESSED_TRANSACTIONS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of asset transactions that are processed in a batch.

columns.name: TOTAL_TRANSACTIONS_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of asset transactions in a batch.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STAGE_CODE
columns.description: Unique code used to identify the type of asset transaction approval.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
